concerns.text: Task T008a lists a dependency on 'T013d0', but no task with ID 'T013d0' exists in the document. The pipeline orchestration is split into T013d0a, T013d0b, and T013d0c. This missing task ID breaks the dependency chain for the memory integration test, leaving SC-004 (Memory Limit) unverified by the specified test task.

Two distinct tasks share the ID 'T027d': one in Phase 4 (US2 Success Criteria Aggregator) and one in Phase 5 (US3 Success Criteria Aggregator). This ID collision means the implementer cannot uniquely identify which task to execute or which output artifact to reference, breaking the traceability for both SC-002/SC-003 and SC-005.

Task T054 requires updating the Constitution (FR-030) title to resolve a 'Single Source of Truth' contradiction. However, the Constitution is a ratified artifact (FR-030) that cannot be modified by a standard implementation task. There is no task defined to formally amend the Constitution or create a constitutional revision artifact, leaving the 'Single Source of Truth' requirement unaddressed by the task plan.

Task T054 references updating 'spec.md' title, but the spec.md provided in the inputs already has the correct title ('Structure-Only Surrogate Model...'). The task description implies the spec still has the old title, creating a stale tag/mismatch between the task description and the current spec state. The task should be updated to reflect the current state or removed if the work is already done.
